english.title: Insufficient lighting intensity in housing for conventionally reared meat chickens - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, were responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when not all houses had lighting with an intensity of at least 20 lux during the lighting periods, measured at bird eye level and illuminating at least 80% of the usable area in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 10(1) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (England) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
